title: SSO login returns HTTP 500 after certificate rotation
resolution: Re-upload the IdP certificate under Settings > SSO.

title: Export job stuck in queued state
resolution: Cancel the job and retry; queue was drained on 2026-08-30.

title: Webhook deliveries retried with 429
resolution: Raise the per-endpoint rate limit from the integrations page.

title: Invoice PDF shows wrong currency symbol
resolution: Set the billing locale on the account.

title: Two-factor codes rejected after timezone change
resolution: Resync device clock; codes are time based.
